answer: Make every identity post a bond that doubles for each additional identity tied to the same operator, and require a hash-chained history of real transactions attested by independent established agents. A farm cannot forge that history; it must earn it one verified exchange at a time. Like nectar gathered flower by flower, each ember of reputation is earned slowly, so a dune of fake accounts collapses: one extra identity costs twice the bond plus weeks of genuine work no script can shortcut.
